title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving support to communities with high anticipatory action that will focus on early response to reduce the humanitarian impact .

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtSomalia is experiencing recurring interplay of drought and floods undermines food security and access to basic services, heightening vulnerability and prompting displacement. The proposed project seeks to address these pressing needs by providing lifesaving Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) interventions. Key activities include,ltbrgtImproving Water Access and Quality: Ensuring that communities have reliable access to clean and safe drinking water. This can involve the Rehabilitating 2 strategic public shallow wells, these two shallow wells are (1) Turo-Wanlun shallow well (Lat: 2.420405, Long: 42.968176), (2) Qod Qod shallow well (Lat: 2.4.1204, Long: 42.982513) one shallow well will be equipped with a solar pumping system, while the other one will be equipped with a hand pump, benefiting 2,500 people. Additionally, the project will establish and train water management committees WMCs and implement water quality monitoring, testing, and treatment.ltbrgtSanitation Facilities: Building and maintaining proper sanitation facilities to prevent the spread of waterborne diseases. This includes the construction of a total of 45 flood-proof emergency latrines and 7 VIP latrines for PwD for 1,560 persons. The project will implement solid waste management activities including Distribution of 80 sanitation tools targeting vulnerable communities from IDPs and rural villages at risk of disease outbreaks. WARDO will organize clean-up campaign to educate communities about the importance of cleanliness and proper waste disposal and a total of 32 clean-up campaigns will be held during the project period.ltbrgtHygiene Promotion: Educating communities about good hygiene practices, such as handwashing with soap, to reduce the incidence of diseases. The hygiene promotion activities include the distribution of 2520 hygiene kits and regular hygiene promotion sessions at communal and facility level.ltbrgtThe overall target beneficiaries of the anticipatory La Nino are 15,000 comprised with 7399 from IDPs and 7601 from the host community from the target villages under the implementation as planned. The project aims to improve access to safe water sources, sanitation facilities, and hygiene education for vulnerable communities, particularly women, girls, and persons with disabilities. Aligned with anticipatory action for La Niña, the project seeks to reduce the risks associated with increased drought and potential flooding by strengthening community preparedness and resilience for rural communities in Diinsoor. enhancing access to reliable water sources and providing flood-proof sanitation facilities, the project aims to mitigate the immediate risks of displacement and the spread of waterborne diseases that often accompany La Niña-related climatic shifts in rural villages of Diinsoor. Somalia.ltbrgtTo utilize the services in place effectively, we will be coordinating and facilitating the joint implementation and integration of serves, such as the maintenance of joint beneficiary mobilization and selection on the bases of the jointly developed selection criteria. To emphasize the integration of the implementation and convergence of the services, we will be coordinate that with the concerned cluster focal points at state level, through the active partners on the ground, there are three clusters concerned with the current anticipatory La Nino, we will synchronize service delivery within the scope of clusters. Harnessing our previous experience in the integration WARDO will be advising the entire partners to have a coordination meeting regularly in which will be used for the exchange of knowledge and lessons learned.ltbrgtlt/pgt
